story.paragraph: A man in black swim trunks picks up a cell phone on an outdoor patio and puts on sunglasses while talking. The scene cuts to another man in a blue t-shirt sitting in a bathroom, talking on a cordless phone. Back on the patio, the first man is now wearing a speedo and continues his phone conversation. He steps into a hot tub, still talking, and eventually sits on the edge with one leg in the water. The scene alternates between the two men having a phone conversation.
story.summary: Two men have a phone conversation, one on a patio getting into a hot tub in a speedo, and the other sitting in a bathroom.
